thread:
riley: Hey @people-ops — quick Q. My checked bag didn’t arrive in Berlin and I had to buy a sweater, socks and some toiletries (paid €162) plus a €48 baggage delay fee at the airport. Paid with my personal card. Can I expense these? Also does this affect my per diem? I have photos of receipts.
people-ops: Aw man, sorry that happened. Yes — emergency purchases and baggage delay fees are reimbursable. Two quick notes: 1) immediate necessities up to €200 don’t need preapproval, 2) if the airline ultimately refunds you, we’ll adjust. Please submit receipts and airline claim number.
max: +1 from my side — riley, if you can drop the receipts and the PNR/claim ID in the expense, I’ll approve.
ella: Finance here — file these as `expense_type: TRAVEL_EMERGENCY` and attach scanned receipts (photo OK). For the baggage delay fee use `expense_type: BAGGAGE_DELAY`. If you paid in EUR we reimburse in EUR on your next payroll run unless you request USD conversion.
riley: Thanks — I’ve got photos. One question: I spent a chunk on breakfast the next morning because I had nothing — does per diem reduce because of these purchases?
people-ops: Per diem is separate. Emergency clothing/toiletries are reimbursed as expenses; per diem for meals stays the same unless your usual spend is materially reduced by the emergency purchase (rare). If you think your meal costs were replaced by the purchase, add a short note in the expense explaining why.
ella: Add: please submit within 30 days. If the airline gives a cash/refund later, mark the expense as `refundable` and we’ll handle reconciliation (you may need to return the airline refund to the company or we’ll offset future reimbursements).
travel-bot: Reminder — include 1) receipt images, 2) airline claim number, 3) card statement showing the charge if amounts are over €100.
riley: Got it — submitting now. Filing as TRAVEL_EMERGENCY, attaching receipts + claim ID. Thanks all :relieved:
people-ops: Thanks @max for the quick approval. Riley — ping us in-thread once expense is submitted and we’ll confirm once processed. :thumbsup:
